description: Standalone responsive inspector panel. Auto docks in-flow on a desktop container and composes a modal TmDrawer (side sheet on tablet, bottom sheet on mobile) on narrower ones; Docked and Sheet pin the choice at every width. For editors with a dedicated frame see TmEditorShell.

parameters.name: Presentation
parameters.description: How the panel presents itself: Auto follows the container layout (docked on desktop, sheet otherwise); Docked and Sheet pin the choice.

parameters.name: Open
parameters.description: Whether the panel is open. Two-way with OpenChanged.

parameters.name: Title
parameters.description: Title shown in the panel header; also the accessible name of the sheet.

parameters.name: HeaderActions
parameters.description: Optional actions rendered in the header, next to the close button.

parameters.name: Width
parameters.description: Width of the docked panel and of the side sheet. Ignored by the bottom sheet.

parameters.name: LayoutMode
parameters.description: The layout the presentation resolves from. Auto follows the nearest unnamed layout context; a forced value renders that mode without a DOM.

parameters.name: InitialMode
parameters.description: The layout rendered before the first measurement.

parameters.name: ResolvedLayoutChanged
parameters.description: Raised when the resolved layout changes. The initial value is not a change.

parameters.name: Class
parameters.description: Extra CSS classes for the root (the docked root, or the sheet root through TmDrawer.Class).
